title: issuer DER encode re-run for every bag cert in build_chain inner find()
description: build_chain()'s inner find() closure calls c.tbs_certificate().subject().to_der() for every certificate in the bag on each iteration of the outer loop. For a bag of 50 certs and a chain depth of 5, this is 250 DER encodes. Pre-computing subject DER for all bag certs once (like anchor_subjects is pre-computed) would reduce this to 50 encodes total — O(bag) vs O(bag * depth).
